data.title: 雪之下阳乃 · 露天咖啡馆的墨镜戏谑注视·「比企谷君，又在用那种腐烂的眼神看世界了呢」
data.description: 【千叶繁华街露天咖啡馆·午后】成熟魔性大姐姐的登场高光。阳乃翘着二郎腿坐在遮阳伞下的藤椅上，米色长风衣敞开露出高领毛衣勾勒出的惊人上围与黑色丝袜长腿。她单手将墨镜稍稍拉低至鼻梁，深邃锐利的凤眸直勾勾盯着你，嘴角扬起让人捉摸不透却心跳加速的妖艳戏谑。
data.location: 千叶商业街露天咖啡座
data.action: 翘腿二郎腿拉低墨镜，风衣敞开黑丝长腿交叠，凤眸戏谑妖艳
data.lighting: 遮阳伞边缘切下的高对比金色阳光与藤椅阴影
data.camera: medium shot, outdoor cafe, sunglasses pulled down, crossed legs, smirk
data.promptProse: Haruno Yukinoshita from Oregairu lounges at a chic outdoor cafe terrace on a sunny afternoon in Chiba, one long black-stockinged leg crossed elegantly over the other. Her beige trench coat hangs open over a form-fitting black turtleneck that accentuates her voluptuous mature bust. She lowers designer sunglasses slightly down her nose with one manicured finger, her sharp dark eyes pinning you with a dangerous, playfully mocking gaze, a knowing smirk playing on her lips.
